column1: # Dependency shims for the x86-64-v2 rebuild.
# The PikaOS packages still declare KF5 and PikaOS-only helpers in their
# control files. Plain Debian sid has neither: the KF5 frameworks were replaced
# by KF6, and the PikaOS-only helpers (otter-*, webapp-manager, cfhdb, pik, ...)
# are not packaged for Debian at all. Without rewriting them, apt refuses the
# whole install set, which is why the ISO could not ship these tools.
# v2/ci/apply-dep-shims.pl rewrites every debian/control found in a source tree
# before dpkg-buildpackage runs, so the rebuilt packages install on a KF6/sid
# base. Dropping a Depends only means "not guaranteed present"; anything the
# desktop itself needs comes from kde-plasma-desktop.
#   <other-name> replace the dependency, keeping any version constraint
# KF5 -> KF6 era names. Dropped: KF5-only modules and PikaOS-only helpers.
# Metapackage closure (pika-meta: gaming, codecs, cuda, rocm, oneapi,
# libreoffice, hhd, ...). These are accelerator/vendor helpers and
# PikaOS-only apps that Debian sid does not ship. Dropping them lets the
# metapackages install on a generic sid base; the parts that do exist in
# sid (steam, lutris, wine, mangohud, gamescope, ffmpeg, ...) stay.
# NOTE: pika-codecs-meta and pika-gameutils-meta are produced by
# pika-meta itself, so they are not shimmed.
# sid ships plain wine; keep the group resolvable.
# The metapackages also pull ffmpeg/gstreamer libraries as :i386 (DVD
# playback). The v2 image is amd64-only and does not enable i386, so those
# qualified dependencies are unsatisfiable; the amd64 halves are kept.
